jobs.title: Sr. Manager, DevOps and AI Enablement
jobs.description: ### **About Point** **✨ Real Impact, Real People:** Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals. **✨ Funding:** With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we're scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage. **✨ Game\-changing Product:** We're building a category defining company in home equity. We've earned a 4\.7 Trustpilot rating and an A\+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000\+ customers. **✨ Great Place to Work:** Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area. **✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:** Work from anywhere in the U.S., while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people\-first culture. **Location** This is a hybrid role based in Palo Alto, with team members expected to work onsite one day per week for in\-person collaboration. **About the role** Point is standing up a new AI Enablement function, and this dual\-mandate leader will own it alongside our DevOps and platform practice. You will run the reliability, delivery, and cloud foundations a lending business depends on, while building the central hub that partners with our corporate functions (HR, Legal, Compliance, Accounting, Finance) and our Operations team (underwriters, processors, closers) to automate and augment their work with AI. Working in close partnership with IT and Security, you will set the technical direction, drive adoption, and define what success looks like across both mandates. It is a rare opportunity to shape how an entire company applies AI to its everyday work, from the platform up. Check out our latest Engineering Blog to learn more about why it's a great time to join Point's Engineering team! **Your responsibilities** * Lead the infrastructure platform and shared\-services organization, and drive key initiatives across the SRE and infrastructure functions. * Own reliability, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), release tooling, and observability, including incident management and security and compliance (SOC 2\). * Stand up and run AI Enablement as the central hub: the sanctioned platform, guardrails, reusable components, and the harder builds. * Partner with corporate functions and Operations to identify high\-value workflows and design agentic AI solutions (LLM\-based agents, tool calling, RAG, orchestration, and n8n / Zapier / custom integrations). * Partner closely with IT and Security to keep enablement safe and compliant, including sanctioned tooling, access, and data\-handling boundaries for sensitive and regulated functions. * Drive adoption of what the team ships: define success metrics, baseline before building, and measure impact such as capacity reclaimed, cycle time, cost per loan, and stickiness. * Define multi\-quarter roadmaps tied to measurable business outcomes. * Stay current on AI and automation advances, and pivot the roadmap based on user feedback and new technical capabilities. * Set technical and quality standards through architecture guidance and review. **About you** * 10\+ years in DevOps, platform, SRE, or infrastructure engineering, with strong technical depth. * 3\+ years leading and growing engineering teams, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management. * Demonstrated experience shipping AI automations to production, including LLM agents, tool calling, RAG, and workflow orchestration. * A track record of tying automation or platform work to quantifiable business outcomes. * Production proficiency with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform), CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Strong observability and incident\-management practice (Grafana, Datadog/NewRelic, or PagerDuty). * Technical fluency to guide and review engineering and automation work (for example Python or equivalent). * Excellent cross\-functional communication, and the ability to earn trust with non\-engineering stakeholders such as Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Operations. **Nice to have** * Built a new function or team from zero in a high\-growth, high\-ambiguity environment. * Fintech or other regulated\-industry experience, and familiarity with PII handling and SOC 2\. * Process\-improvement or RPA partnership experience. * Lending or mortgage operations domain knowledge. Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role in the San Francisco Bay Area \| $269,800 \- $298,200 This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the launch of each position, we benchmark compensation to the appropriate role and level utilizing competitive compensation data from various data sources as references. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job\-related factors, to determine final compensation. ### **Our benefits** * **Generous health benefits:** We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with options for flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings accounts (HSA). * **Unlimited paid time off:** Recharge with unlimited paid time off and 10 company holidays. * **Flexible remote and onsite work:** Our teams work from many different locations and time zones. We support fully remote work and also have an amazing in\-person environment in our downtown Palo Alto, CA HQ. * **Fully paid parental leave:** Point will supplement state Paid Family Leave (PFL) so employees receive 100% of their regular base pay, plus two additional weeks of fully paid leave after state PFL ends. In states without PFL, Point offers up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. In addition, employees also receive 4 weeks of fully paid transition time, during which you may work 2–3 days per week while receiving full base pay. * **Equity:** We offer meaningful equity because we believe in sharing the value you help create. Your contributions directly impact our growth, and your equity gives you a stake in our future success. * **Financial wellness:** We provide 401K retirement plans for employees as well as guaranteed life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage. * **Extra work/life benefits:** We provide monthly stipends for internet, mobile plans, wellness perks, a one\-time home office reimbursement, and company provided equipment including a MacBook and monitor. jobs.title: JUNIOR AI AUTOMATION & SYSTEMS DEVELOPER
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Project Support Services is a dynamic, woman\-owned, disadvantaged business enterprise, and small business enterprise specializing in project management within the realm of Division of State Architecture (DSA) compliance. We collaborate closely with districts, architects, engineers, and other stakeholders to resolve complex issues, close outdated projects, manage ongoing initiatives, and ensure adherence to DSA regulations. Our expertise and strong relationships with DSA staff have helped numerous school districts successfully close projects once deemed impossible. **Job Overview** We are seeking an energetic and motivated Junior AI Automation \& Systems Developer to join our innovative team. In this role, you will support the development and automation of systems that enhance project management workflows and compliance processes. You will work closely with senior developers and engineers to design scalable solutions using modern programming languages and cloud infrastructure. This position offers an exciting opportunity to grow your skills in software engineering, AI automation, and system design within a collaborative environment committed to excellence. BUILD REAL AI SOLUTIONS FOR A GROWING COMPANY Are you the person everyone asks about AI, automation, computers, and new technology? Have you already built custom GPTs, AI agents, automated workflows, integrations, websites, dashboards, or other technology solutions? Project Support Services, Inc. (PSS) is looking for a talented and resourceful AI Automation \& Systems Developer to help us streamline and modernize our business. This is a hands\-on building position. You will work directly with company leadership and our departments to understand how work is currently completed, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop AI agents, prompts, automations, and internal tools that our employees will actually use. This opportunity is open to current college students, recent graduates, early\-career professionals, and self\-taught developers. A college degree is not required. We care more about what you can build, how you solve problems, and whether you can turn an idea into a reliable working solution. THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER AI INTERNSHIP PSS will teach you about our company, departments, clients, and business processes. However, we are not looking for someone who has only used ChatGPT to ask basic questions. You must already know how to build AI agents, engineer prompts, create automations, work with data, connect systems, test your work, and protect confidential information. WHAT YOU WILL DO * Meet with company leadership and employees to understand their daily processes and challenges. * Map existing business processes and identify repetitive, inefficient, or manual tasks. * Build custom GPTs, AI agents, and department\-specific AI assistants. * Write, test, organize, and improve prompts and system instructions. * Create prompt libraries and reusable AI workflows. * Build agents that review documents, analyze information, prepare reports, and produce structured results. * Develop automated workflows using Zapier, Make, Power Automate, n8n, or comparable platforms. * Connect AI tools with company systems using APIs and other integrations. * Create workflows that extract, classify, summarize, and analyze information from PDFs and other business documents. * Work with spreadsheets, databases, dashboards, and data\-visualization tools. * Build or support internal applications, websites, dashboards, and business tools. * Test AI\-generated results for accuracy, consistency, reliability, and usefulness. * Establish human\-review and quality\-control steps for AI workflows. * Troubleshoot technology, automation, and integration issues. * Research new AI tools and recommend practical applications for PSS. * Document completed tools and create clear instructions for employees. * Train employees to use approved AI tools and workflows. * Help PSS establish responsible AI, cybersecurity, and data\-privacy practices. * Maintain the confidentiality of company, employee, client, and project information. EXAMPLES OF PROJECTS YOU MAY BUILD * An AI agent that reviews project reports and calculates completion percentages. * An agent that reads a program\-level PDF and produces results for every project. * Department\-specific AI assistants for Operations, Recruiting, Accounting, Marketing, and Executive Leadership. * Automated reports and notifications based on project information. * AI workflows that extract information from PDFs and enter it into structured reports. * Prompt systems that produce accurate and repeatable business documents. * Automations that reduce manual data entry and repetitive administrative work. * Internal dashboards that display project, staffing, financial, or operational information. * A searchable company knowledge system that helps employees find information quickly. * Integrations between AI tools and Microsoft 365, Sh  levels of technical knowledge. * Welcome feedback and can revise your work until it meets the company’s needs. * Understand the importance of protecting confidential business and client information. * Want your work to make an immediate and measurable impact. * Can work consistently from our Corona office. PORTFOLIO REQUIRED Applicants must submit at least two examples of completed work, such as: * A custom AI agent or GPT. * An automated business workflow. * A prompt system that produces structured and repeatable results. * An API or software integration. * An AI document\-processing workflow. * A dashboard, website, application, or internal tool. * A school, personal, freelance, or professional project demonstrating comparable technical ability. For each example, please explain: * What problem the project solved. * Which tools and platforms you used. * What portion of the project you personally built. * How you tested the solution. * How the completed project saved time, reduced manual work, or improved results. School projects, personal projects, and independently developed tools are welcome. The work does not need to have been completed for an employer. PRACTICAL SKILLS ASSESSMENT Final candidates will be invited to complete a practical, paid skills assessment. The assessment may ask you to review a sample PSS business process and demonstrate how you would: * Map the current workflow. * Identify opportunities for AI and automation. * Build or outline an AI agent. * Write the necessary system instructions and prompts. * Explain how the agent would connect with company systems. * Test the accuracy and reliability of its results. * Establish appropriate human\-review requirements. * Protect confidential company and client information. WHAT YOU WILL GAIN * Hands\-on experience implementing AI throughout a growing company. * The opportunity to build tools that employees will use in real business operations. * Direct access to executive leadership and department decision\-makers. * Exposure to construction consulting, public agencies, government contracting, recruiting, accounting, marketing, and project management. * Projects and measurable results you can add to your professional portfolio. * The opportunity to help shape PSS’s long\-term AI and technology strategy. * Potential consideration for a permanent full\-time role based on performance and company needs. ABOUT PROJECT SUPPORT SERVICES Project Support Services, Inc. is a woman\-owned construction and professional\-services firm headquartered in Corona, California. PSS supports public agencies through DSA compliance and certification services, staff augmentation, construction services, and federal contracting. As PSS continues to grow, we are investing in artificial intelligence, automation, and technology to improve efficiency, accuracy, communication, and consistency. We are looking for someone who is excited to help us build the systems that will support the company’s next stage of growth. HOW TO APPLY Please submit the following: * Your résumé or a summary of your education and experience. * A brief explanation of how you currently use AI and automation. * At least two examples of AI, automation, programming, integration, website, dashboard, or technology projects you have built. * Links, screenshots, videos, or other materials demonstrating your work. * A brief response to the following question: “If you joined a company where employees spend hours reviewing PDFs and manually preparing reports, how would you evaluate the process and determine what should be automated?” Applications that do not include examples of completed work may not be considered. Project Support Services, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, demonstrated skills, merit, business needs, and the ability to perform the responsibilities of the position. Pay: $20\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: BESS Project Engineer, Senior or Staff
jobs.description: **About Redwood Materials** **Redwood is localizing a global battery supply chain that seamlessly integrates recovery, reuse, and recycling** **—** **keeping critical minerals in circulation and driving the energy transition. Founded in 2017,** **we're delivering low\-cost and large\-scale energy storage and producing battery materials in the U.S. for the first time, all from batteries we already have.** Redwood Materials is deploying large\-scale battery energy storage systems that power data centers and the grid, including North America's largest microgrid (63 MWh) for Crusoe, a stationary storage partnership with GM using new and second\-life EV batteries, and a new deployment at Rivian's Normal, Illinois manufacturing plant. The Senior or Staff BESS Project Engineer joins as an early member of a new engineering team working on our Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) product line. You will own the full project lifecycle, from commercial scoping and Business Development handoff through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and a structured handoff to Operations and Maintenance, for a growing portfolio of front\-of\-the\-meter and behind\-the\-meter energy storage and microgrid projects. You are the connective tissue between Business Development, Product Engineering, our internal engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) team, external EPC partners, and customers, and you drive the schedule, manage risk, and make sure every project lands on time, on budget, and to spec. The work rewards people who are comfortable operating where processes are still being built and who want to shape how Redwood delivers energy storage at scale. **Hours** Full\-time, Monday – Friday, with occasional weekend or after\-hours work to meet project milestones **Responsibilities will include:** * Drive end\-to\-end project execution from requirements scoping and Business Development handoff through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and Operations and Maintenance handoff * Own the integrated schedule, budget tracker, and risk register for each assigned project, and proactively identify and escalate schedule or cost risks * Serve as the primary interface between Business Development, Product Engineering, internal and external EPC partners, and customers across all project phases * Track RFI and submittal workflows, change order logs, permitting, interconnection coordination, and all contractual project deliverables * Partner with Product Engineering on equipment selection, bill of materials alignment, and technical scope definition, and retain change control over the Basis of Design across the project lifecycle * Oversee commissioning readiness and test plan execution, and manage structured handoff documentation to Operations and Maintenance * Maintain project data in project management tooling, provide planning inputs and deployment forecasting to leadership, and capture lessons learned into repeatable delivery templates, checklists, and execution standards **Desired Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Program Management, Business, or a related discipline * Deep program management experience in battery energy storage, renewable energy, or utility\-scale power infrastructure such as peaker plants, combined\-cycle generation, and substations; Staff level reflects a broader track record leading a portfolio of projects * Demonstrated experience managing projects from scoping through commissioning and Operations and Maintenance handoff, with ownership of schedule, budget, and risk * Strong cross\-functional communication skills, comfortable managing up, down, and across internal and external EPC, customer, and internal engineering teams * Familiarity with key BESS\-related standards such as UL 9540, UL 9540A, UL 1973, UL 1741, IEEE, NEC (NFPA 70\), NFPA 855, and IEC * Willingness to travel to project sites as needed * A Passion for sustainability and making the world a better place! **Physical Requirements:** * Climbing, standing, and stooping during project site visits * Typing and extended computer work in an office setting **Working Conditions:** * Office environment in San Francisco, CA, with regular travel to project sites * Site visits involve varying conditions, including noise, dust, and temperature extremes at active BESS construction and commissioning sites * Occasional weekend or after\-hours work to meet project milestones * Travel up to 25%, primarily to project sites across the U.S. The position is full\-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience. We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy\-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the Data Cloud Team** ----------------------------- Rippling Data Cloud is a new suite of products that aggregates data from across your company into Rippling, connects it to worker identity, and makes it available for analysis, visualization and action. It preserves and enriches data context to enable precise and accurate answers to your most important and nuanced business questions. It's a complete data stack including data connectors, transformations, visualizations, AI\-powered analytics, and even inbound Zero\-Copy. It understands how all of that data relates to employees, managers, departments, locations, cost centers, permissions, and historical changes in your ever\-changing business. jobs.description: What we are looking for: Are you looking for a career that will make an impact globally and within your local community? We are searching for an entry\-level engineer for our Atlanta, GA office who seeks to advance their career through training, mentoring, and experience in the field and office. As an entry\-level engineer, you will provide engineering/design support to the Atlanta team within our existing solid waste practice which is focused on providing engineering services to private and municipal clients in the landfill, landfill gas, compost and solid waste management industries. Potential projects include providing solutions related to stormwater, industrial wastewater, air quality, landfill gas systems, environmental compliance, permitting, design, construction, operations and environmental monitoring. You will be based in our Atlanta, GA office 5 days/week and will also be conducting fieldwork. jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Serval is an AI\-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real\-world workflows and execute them end\-to\-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high\-volume, high\-friction operational work across their organizations. At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production\-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering. Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving. We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. **Role Overview** ================= With Serval, an automation that used to take a SOW and a quarter now takes a sentence and an afternoon. That one change is why Automation Engineering is becoming the operating model for enterprise services, and why service teams stop being a bottleneck and start being an advantage. As an Automation Engineer, you build Serval's agents directly into the customer's instance, and the tickets stop arriving: onboarding, access requests, approvals, the long tail that clogs a service desk. You'll push Serval past its current limits into new use cases, dogfood unreleased features, bring field ideas back to our product team, and act as a practitioner evangelist for both Serval and Automation Engineering. This is a title we are coining. Nobody has ten years of it yet, so what you build becomes the standard for everyone after you. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Build in the platform:** design and build automations and AI agents inside customers' Serval instances, from onboarding and access requests to the long tail that clogs a service desk. * **Wire up the stack:** integrate Serval with customer systems (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, ServiceNow, Workday) so automations complete end to end. * **Run working sessions:** embed with IT, HR, Finance, and Legal teams, pull the real process out of them, and turn it into something buildable the same day. * **Enable customer builders:** turn what you build into reusable patterns and teach customers' own teams to extend them, so adoption compounds after you leave. * **Partner with Deployment:** work alongside Deployment Strategists to hit the milestones a customer signed up for, and surface risk early when a use case is going sideways. **What You’ll Need** ==================== * Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 2\+ years in a relevant role (IT or service operations, professional services, solutions engineering, business systems, technical support). * Working knowledge of APIs and REST, JSON, and IAM concepts including SSO, SCIM, and provisioning. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to run a working session, challenge a requirement, and translate technical tradeoffs for non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly and work independently across several customer accounts. **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience in an early\-stage startup environment. * Hands\-on time administering or migrating an ITSM platform (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshservice, Zendesk). * Familiarity with IT, security, service management, or workflow automation. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Impact**: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company. * **Growth**: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company. * **Culture**: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun. Compensation Range: $105K \- $220K

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** GibbsCAM is one of the most established CAM platforms in the manufacturing industry, with a history spanning more than 40 years. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team of engineers who take genuine pride in craft, reliability, and building software that real machinists depend on every day. This is a strong growth opportunity for an engineer with a solid foundation in C\+\+ and a curiosity about complex, domain\-rich software. You will work alongside experienced senior engineers who are invested in mentorship and knowledge transfer, and you will have the opportunity to take on meaningful, challenging work from day one. The role suits someone who is eager to learn a specialized domain, comfortable reading and reasoning about code they did not write, and excited to grow their skills within a stable, long\-lived product. This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates authorized to work and residing in the United States. **Primary Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain software features for a large\-scale Windows desktop CAM application, working from specifications provided by Product Management and senior engineers. * Diagnose and resolve defects in existing code, with guidance from senior team members on complex issues spanning large or unfamiliar subsystems. * Perform repair, enhancement, and maintenance of software components, writing clean and well\-tested code that meets the team’s quality standards. * Participate actively in code reviews — both as an author and a reviewer — contributing to a culture of shared ownership and continuous improvement. * Learn and apply relevant domain concepts in CAM and manufacturing as needed to contribute effectively to the product. * Maintain currency with modern C\+\+ and software development best practices, applying them appropriately within the constraints of a mature codebase. * Contribute to technical documentation and assist in keeping internal knowledge bases current. * Consult with senior engineers and management on project status, technical questions, and implementation approaches. **Required Qualifications** * 3–5 years of professional software development experience in a production environment. * Solid proficiency in C and C\+\+; exposure to modern standards (C\+\+11/14/17\) preferred. * Experience reading, debugging, and extending existing codebases — not just writing code from scratch. * Familiarity with Windows desktop application development. * Working knowledge of debugging tools and the ability to systematically isolate and resolve software defects. * Understanding of core data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design principles. * Experience with version control in a team setting. * Solid math fundamentals and willingness to engage with technical or geometric concepts as needed by the domain. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Win32, MFC, COM, or other Windows application frameworks. * Exposure to C\# in a mixed\-language (C\+\+/managed) application context. * Any experience or academic background in CAD, CAM, CNC machining, or manufacturing. * Familiarity with 3D graphics concepts or APIs (OpenGL, DirectX, or similar). * Background or coursework in applied mathematics, linear algebra, or computational geometry. * Experience with Perforce or other enterprise version control systems. * Exposure to large\-project build systems. **Education** * Bachelor’s degree required , with preferred focus in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering. * Equivalent practical experience demonstrating the required technical foundation will be considered. **What to Expect** We understand that a specialized product like GibbsCAM takes time to learn. New team members work with our experienced engineers who provide direction and mentorship during onboarding, and we set realistic expectations for ramp\-up time. We are more interested in hiring someone with strong fundamentals and genuine curiosity than someone who already checks every domain\-specific box. Our team values steady, high\-quality work over heroics. You’ll have the opportunity to grow into greater ownership and technical leadership over time as you build familiarity with the product and codebase. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and implement scalable and robust solutions that meet our customers' needs and exceed their expectations. Some of the key products as part of the digital portfolio are – mobile and desktop applications, vehicle connectivity solutions, mapping services, production, inventory and planning optimization, servicing and repairs, and more. Design, implement, and support identity, access, and profile\-related services for multiple web applications, supporting both internal and customer users. * Implement best practices and standards for software development, including code reviews, testing, and documentation * Mentor and coach junior team members, providing guidance and support to help them grow and succeed * Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, continuously learning and experimenting with new tools and techniques to improve our software development process * Be responsible for the services that are owned by your team, ensuring 24/7 on\-call coverage **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role will be based out of the Scout Motors office in **Fremont, CA.** * This role requires 1\-3 days per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. * Travel: Domestic travel required. Valid driver's license required. #### **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: * **Education/Certifications**: A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field * **Years of Experience** required in type of role: 5\+ years in software development with the ability to lead multiple projects, focusing on back\-end technologies * **Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment, both independently and as part of a team * Proficiency in one of Go (preferably), Node.js, Python, Java, or Ruby * Experience with relational and/or non\-relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL and Redis (preferably), MySQL, and/or MongoDB) * Experience with identity management systems (e.g., Azure AD, AWS Cognito, LDAP, Okta) and directory services for user authentication and management * Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices * Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills, with a passion for finding elegant solutions to complex challenges **Preferred:** * Prior work experience in a manufacturing or automotive environment * Hands\-on experience building on AWS using Go and/or Python #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, AI Agents & Automation
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale. We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us. **What You'll Do** * Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load). * Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure. * Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems. * Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and follow\-up remediation work. * Build and operate AI agents and automation that take on manual, repetitive SRE work directly — not just tools that assist a human doing the work. * Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship. * Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person. * Help define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed. * Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly. **What You'll Bring** * Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system. * AI\-native SRE practice (must\-have): hands\-on, personal experience using AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or custom agents built on Claude/MCP servers) to diagnose, automate, and resolve infrastructure and reliability work. + ***Agentic depth:*** You've built or operated agents that autonomously monitor infrastructure and take action (e.g., an agent that watches system load and scales, remediates, or escalates without a human in the loop) — not just general AI coding assistance. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: AI/ML Engineer **Location:** Atlanta, Georgia **Employment Type:** Full\-time About Sobo Sobo is building an AI\-powered business operator intelligence platform designed to help small and midsized businesses identify operational challenges, uncover opportunities, and connect insights to action. Our platform combines proprietary AI systems, business diagnostics, connected data, and expert support to help business leaders make better decisions across operations, finance, growth, technology, and organizational performance. We are looking for an experienced Senior AI/ML Engineer to work directly with our Head of AI Product \& Development and help build the full Sobo platform. About the Role This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who can take AI capabilities from concept and experimentation through production deployment. You will help architect, develop, test, and scale the intelligence layer behind Sobo. Your work will include model development, data pipelines, AI agents and workflows, platform integrations, evaluation systems, production APIs, and the infrastructure required to deliver reliable AI\-powered experiences to customers. This position is well suited for an experienced builder who is comfortable operating in an early\-stage environment, solving ambiguous problems, and taking meaningful ownership of technical outcomes. What You’ll Do * Work directly with the Head of AI Product \& Development to define and execute Sobo’s technical roadmap. * Design, develop, and improve Sobo’s AI and machine\-learning capabilities. * Build production\-ready AI workflows, agents, recommendation systems, and decision\-support tools. * Develop systems that transform business and operational data into relevant, actionable insights. * Build and maintain retrieval, inference, evaluation, and model\-monitoring pipelines. * Integrate AI capabilities with Sobo’s application, databases, APIs, and third\-party business platforms. * Improve the quality, accuracy, explainability, reliability, and security of AI\-generated outputs. * Create scalable data pipelines for structured and unstructured business information. * Evaluate models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on performance, cost, reliability, and customer requirements. * Translate product and business requirements into practical technical solutions. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-documented production code. * Help establish engineering standards, testing practices, documentation, and deployment processes. * Participate in architecture decisions and help shape the long\-term technical foundation of the Sobo platform. * Assist with the growth and development of Sobo’s future engineering team. What We’re Looking For * Demonstrated professional experience building and deploying AI or machine\-learning systems in production. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML development frameworks. * Experience with large language models, natural\-language processing, generative AI, or related technologies. * Experience developing APIs, backend services, data pipelines, and cloud\-based applications. * Understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI\-agent workflows. * Experience working with structured and unstructured data from multiple sources. * Familiarity with model deployment, monitoring, versioning, testing, and MLOps practices. * Strong understanding of software engineering principles, system architecture, databases, and secure development. * Ability to balance experimentation with the discipline required to ship reliable production software. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively while independently owning major technical initiatives. * Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup where priorities may evolve as the product and customer base grow. Preferred Experience * Experience building AI\-powered B2B SaaS products. * Experience developing multi\-agent or workflow\-based AI systems. * Familiarity with financial, operational, CRM, ERP, payroll, or other business\-platform data. * Experience integrating platforms such as QuickBooks, Xero, Gusto, HubSpot, or similar systems. * Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure. * Experience supporting AI systems involving sensitive business or customer data. * Previous experience in an early\-stage startup or building a product from its foundational stages. * Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish an engineering function. What Success Looks Like In this role, you will help turn Sobo’s product vision into a secure, scalable, and commercially viable platform. Success means shipping dependable AI capabilities, improving the quality of Sobo’s business insights, building systems that can scale with customer adoption, and creating a strong technical foundation for future product and engineering growth. Why Join Sobo? * Help build an ambitious AI platform from an early and influential stage. * Work directly with Sobo’s Head of AI Product \& Development and company leadership. * Take meaningful ownership of architecture, product capabilities, and technical execution. * Solve real operational problems for small and midsized businesses. * Help shape the engineering culture and future technical team. * Join an Atlanta\-based company operating at the intersection of artificial intelligence, business intelligence, and expert\-led execution. Compensation and Work Arrangement This is a paid, full\-time position based in Atlanta, Georgia. Compensation will be determined based on experience, technical background, and the scope of responsibility. How to Apply Please submit your résumé or LinkedIn profile, along with a brief description of an AI/ML product or production system you have helped build. If available, include links to relevant projects, technical portfolios, GitHub repositories, or other examples of your work. Sobo is an equal\-opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on their skills, experience, and ability to contribute to the team. Pay: $69,026\.02 \- $83,128\.11 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Are you a kid at heart looking to build a career with a leading global children's toy, entertainment and digital gaming company? At Spin Master, our unwavering commitment to open mindedness, integrity and innovation is a great part of what has made us an industry leader. How do we stay ahead of the pack? By hiring the best and brightest minds—and that’s why we want you! **Job Description:** -------------------- **Hapiko and the Stickerbox Story** Hapiko, a new part of the Spin Master family, is the creator of Stickerbox, an AI sticker printer for kids. A child holds a button, says "a unicorn riding a slice of pizza through space," and seconds later, a physical sticker prints out. This is powered by a proprietary generation pipeline that turns a child's idea into safe, fun, printed art in just a few seconds. **What will you work on?** You aren’t just one of a dozen ML engineers lost in a Big Tech department. You will own the architecture and performance of the machine learning pipeline that powers Stickerbox, scaling this technology to support a global product launch. This role is designed for a builder who wants to learn exactly how to launch and scale a physical AI product for kids from the ground up. You will make the foundational architectural decisions and translate product requirements into reality. This is a hybrid role, 3 days per week out of our Long Island City office. **How will you create impact?** * Own end\-to\-end latency from a kid's voiced input to a physical printed sticker, and the profiling to eliminate every bottleneck * Design and manage model deployment, versioning, and rollback strategies for a fleet of consumer hardware devices * Optimize batching, caching, and GPU utilization across image generation, speech recognition, and character models to keep the experience fast and affordable * Conduct build\-vs\-buy analysis for hosting and inference architecture and lead any resulting migrations * Design and maintain serving\-side enforcement of product safety, kid\-safe compliance, and automated character\-fidelity checks * Manage the queues, autoscaling, observability, and release engineering that supports the ML generation path **What are your skills and experience?** * Experience deploying and operating diffusion or similar generative ML models in production with real latency constraints * Experience profiling a generation path to optimize for performance and cost * End\-to\-end production ownership experience, including deployment, capacity planning, observability, and on\-call support * Advanced knowledge of ML infrastructure, inference systems, and production software architecture * Experience translating product requirements into scalable technical solutions and roadmaps * Experience with consumer hardware, on\-device/edge inference, ASR, or child\-directed digital products is a strong plus \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-HM1 *The anticipated pay range for candidates who will work in New York City is $166,100 to $221,400 Per Annum. Everyone is welcome in our sandbox and we are committed to an accessible and inclusive hiring process that provides reasonable accommodation to all applicants. jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise \- it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way. We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real\-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most. Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest\-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be. If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you. ### **What you will do** * Build and run the MCP fleet — ship, secure, and patch self\-hosted and managed MCP servers for business apps and databases, and manage the MCP registry. * Own the agent platform other teams build on — the deploy pattern, guardrails, observability, and hosting substrate that let other teams ship agents without you in the loop. * Co\-own the Bedrock runtime and gateway — model access, cost attribution, content\-filtering guardrails, model pinning, and quota management behind an AWS/Okta\-SSO'd gateway. * Make AI spend and usage visible — build the Bedrock\-to\-Snowflake pipeline, identity\-matched, with usage tracking and threshold alerting. * Make the secure path the easy path — own MDM config, desktop client setup, credentials, and auth flows for non\-technical employees; build AI automations across Claude desktop, Slack, and Google Workspace. * Build governance into the platform — route workflows by data sensitivity, enforce least privilege and auditability, and keep unproven models sandboxed away from production data as configuration, not a rewrite. ### **What you will bring with you** * 6\+ years in software engineering, platform engineering, or DevOps, including ownership of something in production that others depended on. * Hands\-on AWS — IAM, ECS or Lambda, CloudWatch, and working VPC knowledge. Required, not a bonus. * Full\-stack range — backend services, APIs, CI/CD, containerized deployments. * Builder, not just integrator — you can write an MCP server or API integration from scratch, not just wire up a managed connector. * Hands\-on with LLMs — comfortable with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and agent development; you've shipped something with them. * Self\-direction — you can take an underspecified task and figure out the parts nobody wrote down. ### **What we look for** * Bias to ship — and to automate whatever you just did by hand. * Ownership of the boring parts — upgrades, credentials, quotas, on\-call. * Candor — you raise problems and disagreements early, even about platform choices. * Judgment on buy vs. build — you'd rather run a small, coherent stack than a sprawling "perfect" one. ### **When you join Sysdig, you can expect** * Extra days off to prioritize your well\-being * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a 3% company match * Maternity and Parental Leave * Mental health support for you and your family through the Modern Health app * Full health benefits package for you and your family The U.S. annual salary range for this full\-time position is between 141,000 and 177,000 USD/year. Your background and passion will set you apart, especially if your career path is different. *Sysdig values a diverse workplace and encourages women, people of color, LGBTQIA\+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply. Sysdig is an equal\-opportunity employer. jobs.title: Lead AI Software Engineer - T. Rowe Price Lab (MD or NYC)
jobs.description: At T. Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi\-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity. Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you. **Role Summary** Positions are available in our New York City office or with our AI Engineering squad in Harbor Point, Baltimore, MD. In either location, you will join a collaborative team of engineers, product owners, and business partners building high\-impact AI products with leverage across the firm. As a Lead Software Engineer on T. Rowe Price Labs' AI Engineering team, you will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of complex production\-grade AI agents and intelligent systems. Rowe Price. **Responsibilities** * Lead the architecture, design, development, deployment, and evolution of complex production\-grade AI agents and intelligent systems. * Set technical direction for across areas such as agent orchestration, tool use, retrieval\-based systems, evaluation frameworks, observability, and guardrails. * Evaluate emerging models, frameworks, tools, and AI engineering approaches and provide technical direction on when and how they should be adopted. * Provide hands\-on technical leadership and mentorship to engineers, raising the bar on architecture, engineering quality, problem solving, and execution. * Lead technical design and code reviews and help resolve complex engineering challenges across teams and systems. * Drive the Build\-Operate\-Transfer model by incubating new AI products, hardening them for production, and partnering with business\-aligned technology teams to transition proven solutions for long\-term ownership and scale. * Ensure AI platforms and abstractions, balancing reusable enterprise capabilities with product\-specific requirements. * Identify and pursue opportunities to apply AI in ways that accelerate workflows, improve decision\-making, and create scalable business impact across the firm. **Business Knowledge** * Engage directly with business stakeholders, product owners, senior partners, and technology leaders to understand priorities and shape solution and technical direction. * Translate complex and ambiguous business needs into robust AI solutions and architectures that support both immediate value and broader enterprise adoption. * Apply strong product and engineering judgment to balance innovation, scalability, business value, risk, cost, security, and long\-term maintainability. * Influence technical decisions across initiatives and communicate complex AI concepts, architectures, risks, and trade\-offs effectively to technical and non\-technical audiences. **Qualifications** engineers through complex and ambiguous technical challenges. * Demonstrated commitment to engineering excellence through setting and upholding standards for automated testing, code reviews, observability, security, and continuous delivery. * Strong communication and influence skills, with the ability to shape technical direction across engineering, product, business, and senior stakeholders. * Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and raising technical capability across teams. * Passion for staying current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and the judgment to distinguish promising technologies from short\-lived trends. **Preferred:** * Experience establishing engineering standards or technical direction across multiple teams. * Understanding of financial markets, asset management, or financial instruments. **FINRA Requirements** FINRA licenses are not required and will not be supported for this role. **Work Flexibility** This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to three days per week from home. **Base Salary Ranges** Please review the job posting for the location of this specific opportunity. $145,000\.00 \- $247,000\.00 for the location of: Maryland, Colorado, Washington and remote workers $159,000\.00 \- $272,000\.00 for the location of: Washington, D.C. $181,000\.00 \- $309,000\.00 for the location of: New York, California Base salary is only one component of our total compensation package. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, which is determined upon company and individual performance. **Commitment to Diversity, Equity,** **and** **Inclusion** At T. jobs.title: Senior Engineer AI Native Delivery
jobs.description: **At Taazaa** Working at Taazaa involves engaging with cutting\-edge technology and innovative software solutions in a collaborative environment. We emphasize continuous professional growth through workshops and training. Our employees often interact with clients to tailor solutions to business needs, working on diverse projects across industries. We promote work\-life balance with flexible hours and remote work options, fostering a supportive and inclusive culture. Competitive salaries, health benefits, and various perks further enhance the work experience. **1\. About the Role** We build and deliver software for clients who expect working systems, not slideware. This role sits within a delivery squad, you own features end to end, from shaping the specification through to production, and you do it with AI coding agents as a standard part of how you work. We're not looking for someone who has simply used Copilot. We're looking for an engineer who has changed how they build because of these tools: writing specifications an agent can execute against, reviewing generated code with real rigor, and knowing when to stop delegating and write it yourself. You should be language\-agnostic by nature. Most of our work is in .NET, Node.js, or Java, but the engineer we want treats the runtime as an implementation detail and picks up whatever the engagement requires. **2\. What You'll Do** * Own delivery of features and services end to end – design, build, test, deploy, and support. * Work directly with clients and product stakeholders to turn ambiguous requirements into specifications precise enough to build against. * Use AI coding agents as a primary tool: decompose work into agent\-executable units, drive them through implementation, and hold the output to the same review standards as human\-written code. * Contribute to and improve our Spec\-Driven Development practice – the specifications, prompts, agent configurations, and review checkpoints the whole team relies on. * Review peers' code and agent\-assisted output; raise design concerns early rather than at merge time. * Operate in Agile delivery: sprint planning, estimation, standups, demos, and retrospectives – with real participation, not just attendance. * Diagnose and fix production issues, including in code you didn't write. * Mentor mid\-level engineers on both engineering fundamentals and effective use of AI coding agents. **3\. What We're Looking For** *3\.1 Required* * 6\+ years building and shipping production software. * Deep hands\-on strength in at least one of .NET / C\#, Node.js / TypeScript, or Java with a genuine willingness to work outside it. * Demonstrated fluency with AI coding agents in real delivery work (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent) – not experimentation, but shipped outcomes. * Solid grasp of API design and testing practices. * Proficiency with RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) or NoSQL stores (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB) – including schema and data modeling, query performance, and knowing which fits the problem. * Real Agile experience in a team that actually practices it. * Cloud experience on at least one major platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP). * Strong written and verbal communication – you'll be working directly with clients. * Authorized to work in the US without sponsorship. *3\.2 Strongly Preferred* * Frontend capability (React, Angular, or Vue) sufficient to own a feature across the full stack. * Familiarity with Spec\-Driven Development or a comparable specification\-first workflow. * Experience across more than one language or runtime in production. * CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure\-as\-code exposure. * Consulting or client\-facing delivery background. *3\.3 Nice to Have* * Built internal tooling, agent skills, or automation that other engineers adopted. * Experience with LLM application patterns – RAG, evals, tool calling. * Domain exposure in healthcare, financial services, or retail/e\-commerce. **4\. Benefits** * Health, vision, dental, and life insurance * 401(k) with employer matching * Paid time off Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hudson, OH 44236

Collaboration \& Leadership * Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, and business analysts to translate complex requirements into technical specifications. * Conduct code reviews and provide constructive, educational feedback to developers and admins. * Develop and maintain technical documentation for system architecture, integration patterns, and deployment runbooks. **What You'll Need:** * **This position is US\-based only.** * 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience in an enterprise environment. * Expert\-level proficiency in Apex (asynchronous patterns, governor limits, test\-driven development) and Lightning Web Components (LWC). * Strong working knowledge of Salesforce Data Cloud / Data 360: data streams, DMOs, identity resolution, segments, and activations. * Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CLI (SFDX), source\-driven development, and managing deployments through multiple sandbox environments to production. * Practical experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins, Gearset, Copado, or similar). * Proficiency in SQL; jobs.title: Cloud Engineer - Professional Services
jobs.description: Job Description Join the Technical Consulting Team Our Technical Consulting Services team within Professional Services is dedicated to delivering cutting edge technology implementation and consulting services. Our mission is to empower clients by enhancing their operational efficiency through innovative and tailored technology solutions. We are seeking a Cloud Engineer, Professional Services to drive continuous improvement and modernization of how Tech Consulting builds, deploys, and operates cloud infrastructure. While this position carries the title of Cloud Engineer, it operates with a different scope than a Cloud Engineer on the core Engineering team. This role sits inside Professional Services and works directly against the needs of a billable consulting practice, introducing modern CI/CD and cloud native patterns, and building the AI enabled workflows that support the team's client delivery work. Key Responsibilities: * Modernize the Release Process for TC: Lead continuous improvement of the team's deployment approach, introducing automated CI/CD pipelines and modern release patterns. You'll design and maintain pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools, automate deployment, patching, and configuration wherever possible, and raise the bar on how efficiently the team ships. * Architect and Deploy New Cloud Solutions: Own the build out of AWS infrastructure supporting Tech Consulting's applications, including EC2, S3, ALB, and Lambda based components. Bring infrastructure as code practices to new and existing work, evaluate opportunities to adopt containers or serverless patterns, and make sound architecture decisions as new client solutions come online. * Create AI Workflows and Automations for the Team: Build and maintain AI enabled workflows and automations that make the broader Technical Consulting team faster and more effective, whether that's automating a recurring engineering task, prototyping an AI assisted tool, or identifying where automation can remove repetitive manual work across the team. * Directly Support Billable Delivery: Unlike a purely internal infrastructure role, your work has a direct line to client delivery. You'll support the technical infrastructure behind billable tech consulting engagements and AI tools, meaning reliability, deployment speed, and infrastructure decisions all have a visible impact on client outcomes, not just internal operations. * Support Enterprise Application Environments: Support applications hosted in Windows Server and IIS environments, and maintain solid SQL skills for schema changes and troubleshooting queries, as part of the team's broader technology footprint. * Monitor and Troubleshoot: Keep an eye on system health and performance using tools like Datadog or CloudWatch, and diagnose and resolve infrastructure issues in both production and staging environments. Required Qualifications: * 3 to 5 years of experience in a cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role. * Hands\-on experience with core AWS services: EC2, S3, ALB, and Lambda. * Comfortable using AI codegen tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code as part of your regular workflow. * Experience with GitHub Actions or a similar tool for building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. * Solid SQL skills, comfortable writing both schema changes (DDL) and troubleshooting queries (DML). * Basic to intermediate Docker experience, with Kubernetes familiarity a plus. * Comfortable working in a Windows Server and IIS environment. * A builder's mindset. You look at a manual, repetitive process and see an opportunity to automate it, whether that's a deployment pipeline or an internal AI workflow. * Strong communication skills. Because this role touches billable consulting work, you're able to explain infrastructure decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Comfort with ambiguity. Much of what this role improves doesn't have an established playbook yet, you'll be building it. Preferred Qualifications: * AWS certification (SysOps Administrator, Solutions Architect Associate). * Infrastructure as code experience (Terraform, CloudFormation). * Scripting experience (PowerShell, Python, or Bash). * Exposure to Azure or GCP, though AWS is primary. * Work Schedule * Availability outside normal business hours as needed for deployments, patching windows, or incident response. \#LI\-D2E **What’s in it For You?** * **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a b catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. jobs.description: Onsite/Hybrid Remote M\-F 20 hrs a week Position Overview The client is seeking an experienced, high\-caliber AS400 Developer/Admin for a long\-term contract engagement. This critical resource will provide essential application maintenance, database management, and application\-level administration services for client’s core IBM AS/400 (IBM i Series) environment. Because the underlying AS/400 hardware partition, operating system, and baseline infrastructure are fully hosted and managed by an external provider, this position does not require hardware or OS\-level systems engineering. Instead, the contractor will focus on application development, software support, database management, and serving as the technical liaison to Ensono for environment\-level modifications. Additionally, the contractor will play a key role in assisting the client IT leadership with database extraction, documentation of legacy business logic, and support for ongoing cloud migration and data archiving initiatives. Key Responsibilities 1\. Legacy Application Maintenance \& Support Maintain, modify, and optimize custom legacy application code written in RPG, RPG III, RPG IV (ILE RPG), RPGLE, and Control Language (CL). Investigate and troubleshoot operational bugs, batch run anomalies, and user\-reported system issues. Update existing logic to adapt to regulatory changes, licensing requirements, and client business process updates. 2\. Application Administration \& Infrastructure Liaison Serve as the primary technical point of contact to coordinate with the hosting provider for system maintenance, OS patching schedules, database utilities, and environmental adjustments. Manage application\-level security configurations, including user profiles, object\-level authority, and verify system audit logs (QAUDJRN) to maintain system integrity. Manage local job queues, active subsystems, and application\-level job schedulers. Coordinate with Ensono’s storage and backup operations teams to ensure application backup windows, disaster recovery testing, and restoration verifications are carried out successfully. 3\. DB2 Database \& Integration Management Query, manage, and tune DB2 for i databases, optimizing SQL queries and indexes to ensure database responsiveness. Support secure, automated file transfers (SFTP/FTP) and interfaces between the hosted AS400 partition and downstream state, regional, or partner systems. 4\. Modernization \& Migration Enablement Cooperate with the client database administrators and cloud architects to extract, clean, and archive legacy tables. Document system flows, database schemas, and interdependencies to facilitate a seamless transition of legacy business logic to modern cloud systems. Required Skills \& Qualifications Experience: Minimum of five (5\) years of hands\-on experience in AS400 (IBM i, iSeries) application development and support. Programming Skills: Exceptional proficiency in RPG IV (ILE RPG), RPGLE, CL, and SQL on DB2 for i. Hosting Coordination: Prior experience working in a hosted/managed AS400 environment, collaborating with external hosting providers (such as Ensono) to resolve infrastructure or environmental issues. Application Administration: Proven experience in IBM i work management, subsystem coordination, application security, and user profile management. Data Integration: Strong background in file transfer automation (FTP, SFTP) and managing external integrations. Highly Valued Skills (Nice\-to\-Haves): Direct experience assisting in legacy\-to\-cloud migrations or data warehousing extractions. Familiarity with modern IBM i tools, such as Rational Developer for i (RDi). Prior experience working in public sector environments or supporting insurance regulatory systems. Required Skills RPGLE, CL, and SQL on DB2 SFTP /FTP Notes: Onsite/Hybrid Remote M\-F 20 hrs a week VIVA is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Viking you will design, productionize, deploy, and operate machine learning solutions that support management decisions. This role bridges data science, data engineering, and software engineering. You will work closely with data scientists, data engineers, analysts, product partners, and software developers to translate experimental models into scalable, reliable, governed production systems on Databricks. The position emphasizes practical MLOps, robust feature and training pipelines, reproducibility, observability, and measurable business outcomes. **Job Responsibilities:** * Design, build, deploy, and maintain production\-grade machine learning solutions supporting demand forecasting, dynamic pricing, inventory optimization, and recommendation use cases. * Partner with data scientists to convert experimental notebooks and prototypes into modular, tested, repeatable training and inference pipelines. * Build and maintain feature engineering, model\-training, batch\-scoring, and real\-time inference workflows using Python, Spark, SQL, Databricks, and MLflow. * Implement MLOps practices for experiment tracking, model registration and versioning, automated testing, CI/CD, controlled promotion, rollback, and reproducibility. * Define and monitor model and operational health measures, including model quality, drift signals, latency, failures, data quality, resource utilization, and compute cost. * Validate model changes against reproducible datasets and established baselines, and assess downstream impact. * Integrate model outputs with business applications and downstream platforms through reliable batch jobs, APIs, and secure data\-access patterns. * Optimize model architecture, feature processing, training, and inference for scalability, reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency. * Implement safeguards and fallback behavior so invalid data or failed optimization does not result in unsafe or misleading recommendations. * Collaborate with stakeholders to translate revenue\-management requirements into technical specifications, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes. * Create and maintain technical documentation, model cards, runbooks, deployment plans, monitoring procedures, and retraining and rollback strategies. * Ensure solutions comply with enterprise data governance, privacy, security, audit, and responsible AI requirements. **Job Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience. * 4\+ years of relevant experience in machine learning engineering, applied data science, data engineering, or software engineering for production ML systems. * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience building maintainable, testable production code. * Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and supporting machine learning models in production environments. * Experience with cloud platforms, with a preference for Microsoft Azure. * Experience with Apache Spark or Databricks and large\-scale data processing. * Knowledge of supervised learning, forecasting, optimization, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experiment design. * Experience with software engineering practices including Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, configuration management, and environment promotion. * Strong problem\-solving, critical\-thinking, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Ability to work independently, manage changing priorities, and deliver in a fast\-paced product environment. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience designing batch and real\-time model\-serving patterns and integrating model outputs into operational applications. * Experience with model explainability techniques, statistical equivalence testing, A/B testing, and business\-impact measurement. * Experience with Azure services such as Synapse Analytics, Event Hubs, Azure Data Lake Storage, or related integration services. * Experience with distributed ML libraries and frameworks such as scikit\-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Spark MLlib. * Experience implementing governed feature stores, lineage, access controls, audit trails, and model approval workflows. **What We Offer You:** * Highly competitive compensation plan. * Salary range $155,000 \- 180,000 annually determined by a myriad of factors including, but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, and other relevant business considerations. * Employees are eligible for annual discretionary bonus. * 401(k) plan with company match. * Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) Viking full\-time regular employees working in the United States can purchase Viking shares through payroll deductions. * Full benefits including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance at a highly subsidized rate (some plans are fully paid by Viking). * Accrue 15 paid vacation days, sick time accrual by state, and 6 paid holidays per year. * Opportunity to take a free and/or discounted cruise. * Highly subsidized gym membership. * Discounts on theatres, theme parks, movie tickets, travel discounts through IATA membership and too many more discounts to name. Viking is a certified Great Place to Work company. This certification is a result of our commitment to excellence, integrity and our teams’ outstanding contributions. **About Viking** Viking (NYSE: VIK) is a global leader in experiential travel with a fleet of more than 100 ships, exploring 21 rivers, five oceans and all seven continents. Designed for curious travelers with interests in science, history, culture and cuisine, Chairman and CEO Torstein Hagen often says Viking offers experiences For The Thinking Person™. Viking has more than 450 awards to its name, including being rated \#1 for Rivers and \#1 for Oceans five years in a row by Condé Nast Traveler in the 2025 Readers’ Choice Awards. Viking is also rated a “World’s Best” by Travel \+ Leisure—no other travel company has simultaneously received such honors by both publications.
